Navigating uncertainties from position of strength
1 Relate to amount attributable to equity holders of the Bank.
3 Refers to non-performing loans ("NPL") as a percentage of gross customer loans

6 Figures reported are based on average LCR for the respective periods, calculated based on MAS Notice 651. A minimum requirement of Singapore Dollar LCR of 100% and all-currency LCR of 100% shall be maintained at all times.
